A little slice of heaven at Cafe Central Pasteur
Oct 2026 • Family
Cafe Central Pasteur is the restaurant attached to a 5 star hotel in Saigon, Sherwood Residence.
We stayed at Sherwood Residence for the last half of our 6 day trip to Saigon. 
One of the main reasons we chose Sherwood Residence was for the Cafe Central Pasteur restaurant and the free breakfast buffet! 
The buffet was outstanding! There was a wide variety of Western and Asian food. Barista coffee was amazing and included. 
The staff are very attentive and careful to meet every need. They went above and beyond to ensure we were satisfied. 
The dinner menu is very reasonably priced as well. In fact, we ate there 2 nights of our 3 night stay! 😄 The dinner menu is moderate but accommodates a variety of tastes. I was really craving a burger for some reason and the beef burger they created was outstanding. 
There is a small wait time when ordering from the menu but that is to be expected and was not excessive by any means. 
Overall we were very pleased with Cafe Central Pasteur and would definitely book at Sherwood Residence again to enjoy it once more! Bravo! 😎🙏🏻❤️

Dinner at this fine establishment
Dec 2019 • Family
Our main server was Nhu and she was awesome ! Her english was really good so she understood our special requests. Tram helped with our bill at the end.
 Everyone was super kind,friendly and professional. The food at this restaurant was exceptional! I've had spring rolls in California, Virginia and Pennsylvanian Vietnamese restaurants ,but none half as good as these and the peanut sauce was out of this world !. 
 This restaurant is gourmet food for much lower prices ! I loved the quality of food and the attentive service here above any Vietnamese restaurant I've experienced to date.The ambiance is beautiful, clean and relaxing .We will be back before our trip ends for sure 👍🏼.

Sincerely,
